tools.name: archive_and_ocr_scanned_contract
tools.description: Moves a scanned contract PDF into the matter's archive folder and then runs OCR on it to produce a searchable PDF in that folder.

params.name: src_path
params.description: Path to the scanned contract PDF

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Matter identifier used to pick the archive folder

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/legal/matters")


@function_tool
def archive_and_ocr_scanned_contract(src_path: str, matter_id: str) -> str:
    d = ARCHIVE_ROOT / matter_id / "contracts"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = Path(src_path)
    dst = d / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    out = d / (dst.stem + "_ocr.pdf")
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["ocrmypdf", "--skip-text", str(dst), str(out)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return "OCR failed: " + r.stderr[-300:]
    return str(out)

tools.name: move_closed_matter_files
tools.description: Moves all files for a closed matter from the active matters folder into the closed matters archive folder.
tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

ACTIVE = Path("/srv/legal/active")
CLOSED = Path("/srv/legal/closed")


@function_tool
def move_closed_matter_files(matter_id: str, year: int) -> str:
    src = ACTIVE / matter_id
    target_dir = CLOSED / str(year)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dst = target_dir / matter_id
    moved = shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    return f"Moved {matter_id} to {moved}"

tools.name: run_conflict_check_and_notify
tools.description: Runs the conflict-of-interest check script for a prospective client and emails the results to the compliance officer.

params.name: compliance_email
params.description: Email address of the compliance officer

tools.code:
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage


def run_conflict_check_and_notify(client_name: str, compliance_email: str) -> str:
    conflict_check_process_result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "/opt/legal/scripts/conflict_check.py", "--client", client_name],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    notification_message_object = EmailMessage()
    notification_message_object["Subject"] = "Conflict check results: " + client_name
    notification_message_object["From"] = "conflicts@firm.example.com"
    notification_message_object["To"] = compliance_email
    notification_message_object.set_content(
        conflict_check_process_result.stdout or conflict_check_process_result.stderr
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.firm.example.com", 587) as smtp_connection_to_server:
        smtp_connection_to_server.starttls()
        smtp_connection_to_server.send_message(notification_message_object)
    return "Sent results to " + compliance_email
